description: This file defines the IntentFactory object which centralizes the creation of system intents related to app settings, specifically providing a method to generate an intent that opens the application's details settings page.

classes.name: IntentFactory
classes.description: A singleton object that provides factory methods to create common system intents used across the app.

methods.name: appDetailsSettings
methods.description: Creates and returns an Intent that opens the app's system settings page for app details, including the application info screen.
